title: Chinese president visits the US – level 1
paragraphs: President Xi Jinping from China visits President Donald Trump in the US. They have a big meal together and say friendly words. But they do not solve many big problems.

The presidents have different ideas about money, AI, or Taiwan. They only agree to help trade for two short months. Another problem is with journalists. Some news companies can not show video of the visit.  One photo of the presidents is edited. AI changes it.
The visit was good for talking, but the two big countries still have many problems to solve together. As a friendly gift, China will send two new giant pandas to a zoo in Atlanta.
